data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 6
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
¡Vamos!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Let’s talk… Vamos a charlar  
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres  
Market vibes calling.

[Verse]
Stalls bustling, colors alive  
Vendors greet us as we arrive  
Good morning… Buenos días  
The day’s just begun.  
Nice to meet you… Encantado  
Smiles and laughter, feeling glad.  
Thanks a lot… Muchas gracias  
For the fruits and fun.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Let’s talk… Vamos a charlar  
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres  
Market vibes calling.

[Verse]
Hey there… Oye, ¿qué tal?  
Come join us, let’s have a ball.  
Of course… Claro que sí  
We’ll find treasures, just wait and see.  
Sorry… Perdón, excuse me  
Pardon the crowd, it’s quite busy.  
Okay… Vale, no hay problema  
Let’s keep exploring, no pausa.

[Bridge]
Come in… Pasa, pasa  
Feel the rhythm, feel the salsa.  
Tell me… Cuéntame, dime  
What you’re seeking, I’ll help you find it.  
Goodbye… Adiós, hasta luego
